GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 560 (14 Dec 46) GC
(SCAPIN - 1403)
APO 500
14 December 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Processing Japanese Crew Members of United States Owned Ships Which Have Been Released from Repatriation Service.
1. Reference is made to memorandum from the Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, file AG 370.05 (7 May 46)GC, (SCAPIN-927), dated 7 May 1946, subject, "Repatriation," as amended.
2. Repatriation ship John W. Weeks, VH-007, is scheduled to arrive at Uraga on or about 20 December 1946. Ship is carrying 1,372 crew members of former Japanese operated ships which have been released from repatriation service and returned to the United States.
3. The Imperial Japanese Government will:
a. Medically process these returning crew members in accordance with the provisions of Annex V, memorandum referred to in paragraph 1 above.
b. Thoroughly chock the baggage and personal possessions of the persons referred to above to insure that they do not have in their possession contraband articles or items readily salable on the black market which are in excess of their immediate needs. Take up against individual receipt all such unauthorized items in possession of these individuals.
c. Hold items so confiscated in safe custody in accordance with paragraph 2 f (2), Annex VI to memorandum referred to in paragraph 1 above.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
